name: Duotone
author: Ambrotype
description: The photo in two inks: one colour for the shadows, another for the highlights, keeping its brightness. A colour effect, so it is as quick as a LUT.

params.name: colour
params.label: Colour
params.description: How strong the two inks are; 0 is black and white.

params.name: balance
params.label: Balance
params.description: Where the shadow ink turns into the highlight ink.
